# Synthetic WUA fixture

`synthetic.wua` is 681 bytes. It contains only generated text, with root RPX,
base v0, update v208, DLC v80 and unrelated nested entries. The 170000-byte
update text crosses three compression blocks. It contains no Nintendo assets.

SHA-256: `2549860285ead57da0a7213717730f92d873ff589ce64cf9a6a0fe6a4d654a2b`.
Generated by the pinned upstream ZArchive writer at
`965b66c8d67b6b7e30fd63b3b75aa91a99ff303b` with zstd 1.5.7.
The writer is needed only to reproduce this fixture and is never built or
fetched by setup or tests. Tests build the actual vendored reader locally.

To reproduce from the repository root, use a private temporary checkout of
[Exzap/ZArchive](https://github.com/Exzap/ZArchive) at that commit, then run
(the example uses the macOS Homebrew zstd paths; Linux needs `libzstd-dev`):

```sh
fixture_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
git clone https://github.com/Exzap/ZArchive "$fixture_tmp/upstream"
git -C "$fixture_tmp/upstream" checkout 965b66c8d67b6b7e30fd63b3b75aa91a99ff303b
clang -c "$fixture_tmp/upstream/src/sha_256.c" -o "$fixture_tmp/sha.o"
clang++ -std=c++20 -I "$fixture_tmp/upstream/include" \
  -I/opt/homebrew/include -L/opt/homebrew/lib \
  tests/fixtures/wua/generate.cpp "$fixture_tmp/upstream/src/zarchivewriter.cpp" \
  "$fixture_tmp/sha.o" -lzstd -o "$fixture_tmp/generate"
"$fixture_tmp/generate" "$fixture_tmp/synthetic.wua"
shasum -a 256 "$fixture_tmp/synthetic.wua"
```

Different zstd versions may produce different compressed bytes. Compare member
contents, or use zstd 1.5.7 for the recorded fixture hash. Remove the private
temporary directory when finished. Malformed archives in the tests are mutations
of this fixture in temporary directories; none is a game dump.
